what_this_file_is: G3.2b.4B1.2.3a. Four real-slide runs of the same four trajectories: the natural timing before and after the fix (on this demo slide the foreground floor finishes before HOT ever asks, so the defect cannot occur), and the FORCED window (--slow-floor 400 --dwell 9000) in which the foreground floor is still running when _prepare_centre_floors() fires, which is the real machine's timing. The before/after pair of forced runs uses identical settings.
honesty: the OS page cache was NOT dropped; nothing here is a cold disk read
the demo slide biopsy.ome.tif is opened read-only; the larger slide in the user's own log is not available here and no number is invented
--slow-floor sleeps on the floor worker thread only and changes no decision, no key and no pixel; --dwell only lengthens the stand-still
